title: Xbox Live Hidden Security Flaw

scenes.text: Xbox Live once let anyone join a game with just a name tag
scenes.query: Xbox Live early multiplayer security flaw 2002

scenes.text: In 2002 a simple packet could spoof a player’s Xbox Live ID
Microsoft patched it only after a high‑profile tournament was disrupted
The bug was caused by an overlooked debug console left on in retail units
